## Dataset

Data provenance: REAL | 4 rides, 297 windows (Smooth 194, Rough 60, Pothole 8, Irregularity 35). Mount filter: handlebar; 1 stationary window(s) dropped. Windows per class: Smooth 194, Rough 60, Pothole 8, Irregularity 35. Rides per class: Smooth 3, Rough 1, Pothole 1, Irregularity 1.

| ride | mount | duration (s) | sampling (Hz) | GPS fixes | labelled intervals | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bump | handlebar | 57.8 | 100.0 | 59 | Smooth 4, Pothole 3 | speed bumps / regular bumps (Pothole proxy) |
| irregs | handlebar | 61.7 | 100.0 | 63 | Smooth 14, Irregularity 13 | irregular object / obstacle crossings (Irregularity) |
| rug | handlebar | 37.9 | 100.0 | 41 | Rough 1 | gravel (Rough) |
| smooth | handlebar | 37.1 | 100.0 | 36 | Smooth 1 | clean path (Smooth; central part only) |
| pocket | pocket | 74.4 | 100.0 | 77 | Pothole 1 | phone in coat pocket; mixed events; orientation test only |

## Protocol

- Blocked CV: blocks of 15 s inside each ride (14 blocks), 3 folds (StratifiedGroupKFold over blocks, seed 0), training windows within 2 s of a test window removed (purge).
- Why not ride-grouped CV: each of Rough, Pothole and Irregularity was recorded in a single ride, so holding a ride out removes the class from training.
- Metrics are pooled over all out-of-fold predictions (fold mean ± std in a separate column). Event metrics: a labelled event is detected if a predicted event of the same type overlaps it within ± 1.0 s; counts only (k/n), false alarms over 0.318 km of evaluated riding.
- No tuning on test folds; augmentation / synthetic windows only on training folds.

## In-sample vs cross-validated

RF on its own training windows: macro-F1 0.961, accuracy 0.987 (297 windows) vs blocked-CV macro-F1 0.778. The in-sample score is not an evaluation; the gap (0.183) measures overfitting.

## Limitations and honest caveats

- Tiny dataset: 4 handlebar rides, 297 windows, 0.318 km evaluated, one session. Every number here is a property of this session, not of cycleways in general.
- Blocked CV inside rides (blocks of 15 s, purge 2 s) is optimistic: test blocks share the road, the day, the phone and the rider with the training blocks. Ride-grouped CV is impossible because Rough lives in 1 ride, Pothole lives in 1 ride, Irregularity lives in 1 ride.
- Overfitting gap: in-sample macro-F1 0.961 vs blocked-CV 0.778 (gap 0.183).
- Pothole has only 3 labelled events (< 10), and they are speed bumps used as a pothole proxy: every Pothole number is anecdotal.
- Pothole / Irregularity confusion: 6 windows swapped between the two classes; merging them into one Impact class gives macro-F1 0.885 (diagnostic only).
- Speed confound: speed alone gives macro-F1 0.342 (chance ~0.25) and class mean speeds differ by x1.60: part of what the model learns may be 'which recording / which speed', not the road. Compare with the no-speed row.
- Pocket test inconclusive: only Pothole 0/1 event(s) on 2 windows.
- Severity (1–5) is an uncalibrated heuristic (fixed acceleration bins), not a measured damage level; segment bands inherit that.
